source: Kajal's integration list (16 Sep 2026) and admin/CRM v0.2; one row per integration the yeslyf app depends on (phase 10b, Vatsal, 16 Sep 2026)
note: Fields: id (I01..), category, vendor (chosen; 'internal' rows and 'not decided' are skipped by the vendor cross-check), alternatives (only where the choice is still open), role, screens (v0.2 screen IDs; ['all'] means every live screen), gates (launch | execution switch | later), fallback (screen ID plus what happens if the vendor slips), owner (comma-separated first names; Kajal, Vatsal or Spinach, Gaurav and Raafiya on the HoA Core Platform since they give the API details, Gaurav on DevOps, Compliance and Harish on the store declarations; Vatsal is the PM for yeslyf, not a vendor owner; Vatsal, 16 Sep 2026), status (not started | in talks | agreement signed | sandbox | production | dropped; every row starts at not started until its owner sets it), agreement_date, sandbox_date, production_date, docs_url, cost (kept off the board: the board is public, so the field stays empty), notes, cause. mentions: screens that only name the vendor without using it (the cross-check does not flag them). I00 sorts first: the corporate RIA registration the contracts and sandboxes wait for. to_be_verified is written by scripts/build_integrations.py: 'to be verified: screens' when the v0.2 screens data names the vendor on a screen the row does not list, or the row lists a screen that is not live in v0.2. choice (phase 12, minutes 16 Sep 2026, item 12): final or open per row, seeded here and edited on the page like owner and status (the latest board row wins); final_since is the date the seed became final, read by the Tracker's daily update. The date by which every row is final is a page-level value (board row integrations / final_by), not a row field.
